name: io.github.iowarp/sac-mcp
title: CLIO Sac
description: MCP server for analyzing SAC seismic-waveform files and TAR archives: inspect members, compute...

tools.name: inspect_archive
tools.description: Inspect a staged SAC file or TAR archive and summarize its SAC waveform members: count, a sample of member names and sizes, and the inferred stations and phases. Read-only; a good first step before computing statistics or plotting.

tools.name: compute_trace_statistics
tools.description: Compute per-trace amplitude statistics (min, max, mean, std, peak_abs) plus header metadata (npts, delta_s, begin_s, end_s) for SAC traces in a file or archive. Read-only; bounded by max_traces.

tools.name: plot_traces
tools.description: Plot selected SAC traces from a file or archive to a PNG artifact. Traces are amplitude-normalized and vertically offset. Writes a file; returns the output path, plotted member names, and render duration.

tools.name: analyze_sequence
tools.description: Compute the descriptive statistics of a saved earthquake catalog: completeness magnitude (Mc), the Gutenberg-Richter b-value with uncertainty, the largest event, the Bath-law magnitude gap to the second-largest, the share of events before vs after the largest, the spatial extent, and the Omori post-event rate decay. Returns statistics ONLY - it does not classify the sequence.

tools.name: plot_sequence
tools.description: Render the three-panel earthquake-sequence figure from a saved catalog: (1) an epicenter map sized by magnitude and coloured by time, (2) the Gutenberg-Richter magnitude-frequency distribution with an optional b-value fit line, and (3) the cumulative count over time. Writes a PNG and returns its path; pass mc/b_value to draw the G-R fit line.

resources.name: sac_capabilities
resources.description: What this server can do and the inputs it accepts.

prompts.name: analyze_sac_archive
prompts.description: Guided workflow for inspecting and analyzing a SAC file or archive.

prompts.name: characterize_sequence
prompts.description: Guided workflow for characterizing a saved earthquake catalog.
